logp.method_description: An 80:20 octanol/water solution and 80:20 water/octanol solution were prepared and inverted by rotation for 16 h at room temperature. After 16 h, rotation was stopped and solutions were allowed to separate, yielding a water-saturated octanol solution and an octanol-saturated water solution. Then, 1–4 were diluted to 100 μM in a 50:50 saturated octanol/saturated water solution inside an Eppendorf tube. Each Eppendorf tube was then shaken ∼100 times and given 16 h to separate at room temperature. Following incubation, the aqueous and octanol layers were separated and analyzed by UV/Vis. The partition coefficient was obtained from the difference in aqueous absorbance and octanol absorbance at λMLCT. All measurements were taken in triplicate.
